parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope

parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match

Core Components ### Points - Every POP contains a set of points with attributes. - **Key Attribute**: `P` (Position), a 3D vector (float3) defining a point’s location. - **Other Attributes**: Include `Color` (float4: red, green, blue, alpha), `Normal (N)` (float3), and user-defined attributes. ### Primitives - **Types**: - **Point**: 1 point. - **Line**: 2 points. - **Line Strip**: Multiple points (open or closed). - **Triangle**: 3 points. - **Quad**: 4 points. - Primitives are defined by vertices (indices into the point list) and can have their own attributes. ### Attributes - **Types**: Scalars (e.g., `Weight`), vectors (e.g., `P`), matrices, or arrays (e.g., `float4[5]`). - **Data Types**: Float (32-bit), double (64-bit), integer (32-bit), unsigned integer (32-bit). - **Creation**: Generated via POPs like `Attribute POP` or on-the-fly by specifying new names in output scopes. ## 3.
